            selected_batches = rng.choice(unique_batches, size=n_select, replace=False)
        else:
            selected_batches = unique_batches

        mask = np.isin(batch_train, selected_batches)
        indices = _sample_balanced_subset(batch_train, mask, selected_batches, rng, n_sub_max)

        if len(indices) < 50:
            continue

        X_sub = X_train_z[indices]
        Y_sub = Y_svd[indices]

        model = KernelRidge(kernel='rbf', **params)
        model.fit(X_sub, Y_sub)

        # Predict in chunks to manage memory
        chunk_size = 5000
        n_test = X_test_z.shape[0]
        for start in range(0, n_test, chunk_size):
            end = min(start + chunk_size, n_test)
            chunk_pred = model.predict(X_test_z[start:end]).astype(np.float32)
            pred_svd[start:end] += chunk_pred

        # Free memory
        del model, X_sub, Y_sub
        gc.collect()

    pred_svd /= n_models
    # Map back to RNA space
    Y_pred = np.dot(pred_svd, svd_y.components_)
    return Y_pred.astype(np.float32)
